$comment: Machine-readable ledger of the Google Drive backup area for shdwelf/Html5, as audited on 2026-10-04. Narrative: docs/drive-repo-sync-2026-10-04.md. Re-check the repository side with: node scripts/drive-sync-audit.mjs
$comment_tooling: The rsync-style sync channel. The manifests fully determine the comparison and are ~1 KB per 100 files, so the diff runs on hashes alone and bytes move only for the files proven missing. Nothing here can run until the Drive files are link-readable; fetch.py reports NOT-SHARED rather than writing a sign-in page to disk.

$comment_drive_gaps: Gaps on the Drive side, carried forward from the Drive area's own STATUS.txt and READ ME FIRST.txt and re-checked here.

drive_gaps.item: No Git history for Html5 exists on Drive. Html5.bundle was declared by two mirror runs and uploaded by neither; every Html5 artifact on Drive is a working-tree snapshot with no commit history.
Newest full Drive snapshot is 2026-09-29 (6635490, 1342 files). main has since reached 3fbea9b with 2164 tracked files. The 2026-10-04 upload is a 34-file patch, not a snapshot.
shdwelf/Html5-sync-incoming (~380 MB) reported public since 2026-08-31 and is not backed up in any form. Unverified by this audit — no GitHub access to that repository from here.
bip39-haiku-workbench.bundle (3,576,209 B) present but its integrity was never verified against a recorded hash.
Raw .bundle/.xdc/.wasm/.bin uploads are silently mangled by UTF-8 re-encode (a 65,552 B probe stored as 118,711 B; a 400,057 B .xdc stored as 726,579 B). Wrap binaries in .zip or .tar.gz.
Five same-named '2026-09-27 full mirrors' folders were consolidated into one; a sixth from 14:23 was left alone.
